name: rtc-ci-tooling-vercel
description: NOT a workspace package. Pins the Vercel CLI and its whole transitive tree under an npm lockfile (sha512 integrity) for the deploy workflows; installed by scripts/install-vercel.sh. 57.x is deliberate: 58.0.0 broke `vercel pull` under env-var project linking (docs/STATUS.md). OVERRIDES: vercel@57.0.0 exact-pins deps carrying 30 known advisories (1 critical: tar) — and 59.23.1 still carries 29, so upgrading does not help. Each override lifts ONE vulnerable package to its patched line; `npm audit` on the lockfile is 0. Delete an override once upstream ships the fix. Evidence + A/B `vercel build` smoke test: docs/adr/ADR-007-ci-security-tooling.md.
